title: Dualtron Victor Luxury Plus Steering Column
body_html:
The steering column designed for the Dualtron Victor Luxury Plus. It has channels for routing the wiring: the right side carries the right brake sensor and throttle cable, and the left side carries the left brake sensor, headlight and horn multiswitch. It also has channels for the Victor Luxury Plus LED PCB and its plastic covers with the Dualtron logo.

Supplied without screws. To install it you'll need 50 mm M6 hex screws, M6 hex nylon nuts and M6 washers.

Fits: Dualtron Victor Luxury Plus, Victor Luxury Plus (Gen 2)

title: Rovoron R7 Pro
body_html:
The all-new R7 Pro is here and it's a game changer. Dual motors, dual suspension, and a foldable frame engineered to dominate every ride, from daily commutes to weekend adventures.

  • Blistering 40 mph top speed from dual 900W brushless hub motors (1,800W combined) — true dual-drive power that pins you back every time you twist the throttle
  • 50–55 miles of range from a 60V 42.4Ah Samsung battery (21700 cells) — go further, ride longer, worry less
  • Stop on a dime with fully hydraulic NUTT disc brakes plus ABS + EBS electric braking — confident, controlled stopping power when you need it most
  • 11" no-flat tires — zero maintenance, zero flat-tire headaches, built to take on any terrain
  • Dual-channel controller (60V 50A, 25A per motor) mounted directly to the aluminum frame for serious heat dissipation under serious demands
  • Custom-tuned front and rear spring suspension, independently tuned for a plush, controlled ride no matter what's underneath you
  • All-new EY3 display with Dualtron App connectivity — your ride data, in real time, right at your fingertips
  • Forged-aluminum folding mechanism with quick-release stem — collapses in seconds for storage or transport
  • 105 lbs, 220 lb max load, full lighting suite with headlight, taillight, hazard lights, and turn signals — engineered to be seen, day or night

title: Drytunes Portable Waterproof Floating Bluetooth Speaker
body_html:
DryTunes Portable Bluetooth Speaker

The DryTunes portable Bluetooth speaker from Yak Power is designed for use in marine and outdoor environments. This waterproof, buoyant speaker features a magnetic mounting system and synchronized multi-speaker playback.

Key Features

  • Party Button: Link unlimited speakers within a 200ft range for shared music playback.
  • Audio Output: Maximum volume of 103dB.
  • Battery Performance: Dual lithium batteries provide up to 10 hours of playback at full volume and 40+ hours at half volume (easy listening).
  • Durability: IP67 waterproof rated and buoyant.

Mounting and Versatility

The speaker includes a removable magnetic base with a 1/4-20 threaded insert. It is compatible with most action mounts for use on handlebars, scooter stems, and grab rails. The base is compatible with many magnetic mounts (north pole up) and includes a rail-mountable steel pad and t-nut.

Product Specifications

  • Dimensions: 7.75in x 3.5in x 2.75in
  • Power: 4800mA total battery capacity
  • Connectivity: Bluetooth
  • Waterproof Compliance: IP67. Note: If fully submerged, external speaker pockets may fill with water causing temporary sound distortion; the unit will return to normal play once dry.

Includes

  • Magnetic base with rail-mountable steel pad and t-nut
  • USB charging cable
  • Wrist strap

title: Bazooka G3 Party Bar MINI Portable Bluetooth Speaker
body_html:
• One-Click “Party Button” music-sharing technology lets you choose who is gonna “DJ” and who is gonna “Listen”. Unlimited pairing within range (150ft radius). The DJ will have full control over the music and LED lights. Note: The (P) Party Button on G3 Party Bars must be BLUE (Single Listener Mode) or PURPLE  (DJ Broadcast Mode) for the speaker to be visible and available for pairing in your mobile device’s Bluetooth settings.
    Download the party details here! 

  • Integrated rechargeable Lithium power pack for up to 70 hours of music playback

  • Integrated USB MP3/4 music playback and mobile device charging port.

  • Rugged comfort grip handle and padded shoulder strap for easy carry down to the beach or wherever the Party is gonna be!

  • Includes tripod mounting legs for convenient use on the beach, or anywhere you don't want it sitting on the ground!

  • Includes universal tripod 1/4-20 threaded insert and optional suction cup mount for secure use on tailgates, and other smooth surfaces.

  • Includes home charging adapter and features a 12 volt charging system that allows the internal battery to be charged when hardwired to your vehicle (Full Installation Kit sold separately)

  • Optional Scooter mounting clamps. (sold separately)

  • G3 Mobile App for iOS and Android

  • IP66 Waterproof certified

Description 

The Bazooka portable Party Bar MINI with LED Illumination System is the most robust portable entertainment system available.

Featuring the same Class D, 450-watt max power amplifier, marine-grade speakers (including end-loaded woofers), LED lighting system and USB charging with thumb drive music playback as its G3 big brothers, the Party Bar MINI sets a new standard in portable audio. Designed to go wherever you go, the MINI stands alone as the most versatile portable entertainment system available. Attach the tripod legs and enjoy a day at the beach, spin on the suction cup mount, stick it to your tailgate, and party at the ballpark with your friends before the big game, or just sling it over you shoulder and head out for a picnic with your family. Regardless of where you want to go, the MINI is ready to go with you. We even have a quick release electric scooter mounting clamp (sold separately).

The Party Bar MINI packs 12 cells of integrated Lithium battery insuring the Party doesn't end until you want it to!

There's nothing worse than a dead battery that ends the music, kills the mood, and stops the Party! Ugh! For that reason, we stuffed as much battery as could possibly fit inside the new Party Bar MINI. Featuring 12 cells of integrated lithium batteries, the MINI pound for pound has more battery power than any other portable audio system on the market! Lasting up to 70 hours in easy listening mode, the MINI will create the ambiance at the campsite all weekend, or crank out 128dB of sound for 13.5 hours if you can party that long! It even has an integrated USB charging port and enough battery to recharge your mobile device.  (Note: battery life estimates are based on starting music playback with a fully charged battery and with the LEDs turned OFF)

One-click Party Button music sharing technology - pair unlimited Mini Party Bars together within range (150ft radius)

With Party Button music sharing technology and one-click “Party Button" pairing, anyone with a MINI can join the PARTY. Simply choose who will “DJ” and who will “Listen” and get the “Party” started. The DJ will have full control over the music and LED lights for everyone who has joined the Party! The MINI will also wirelessly link to any Party Button enabled product whether that be one of our larger G3 Party Bars on your ATV, SxS, boat, or golf cart or any other brand audio system using our Party Stick USB wireless adapter (model: INV-USB sold separately). The Party Stick USB adapter lets you wirelessly link any audio system together - meaning you can take the Party Bar MINI to shore while still being linked and playing the same music as your boat's audio system out on the sandbar!

FEATURES

UNLIMITED PAIRING WITHIN RANGE (150ft RADIUS)

MARINE-GRADE SPEAKERS, INCLUDING END-LOADED WOOFERS AND FRONT FIRING TWEETERS

450-WATT PEAK POWER INTEGRATED AMPLIFIER with easy pair Bluetooth and auto connect

WATERPROOF 3.5MM AUXILIARY INPUTS allow you to connect to any smart device or mp3 player with a 3.5mm audio jack

body_html: The Battery Connector for Dualtron Storm is a female connector designed specifically for the Dualtron Storm electric scooter. It serves as the interface between the battery and the scooter's electrical system. This connector features a female plug that securely connects to the corresponding male connector on the battery. It ensures a reliable and stable connection, allowing for efficient power transmission to the scooter. The Battery Connector is an essential component for the proper functioning of the Dualtron Storm and is made to meet the manufacturer's specifications.

title: Dualtron Tubeless Valve
body_html: The Dualtron scooter Valve is designed for tubeless tires and is compatible with specific Dualtron models, including Dualtron Thunder, Dualtron 3, Dualtron Thunder 2, Dualtron Achilleus, Dualtron Storm, Dualtron Storm Ltd, Dualtron X, and Dualtron X2. Please note that this valve is unique and sensitive, so care should be taken during tire replacement to avoid cuts or damage. If you're not experienced with fitting tubeless tires, consider purchasing a tire already fitted on the rim, which eliminates the need for a separate valve. You can also contact us to request a tire pre-assembled on the rim. This product includes one tubeless valve.
